comment: Prominent button at the bottom of a meal's screen that records the meal as eaten. An action, not the state. Short: shares a row with Skip.
en: Mark as Eaten
es: Marcar como hecha

comment: VoiceOver label of the button that records the meal as eaten.
en: Mark as eaten
es: Marcar como hecha

comment: Button beside 'Done' at the bottom of a meal's screen that takes back marking the meal as eaten.
en: Undo
es: Deshacer

comment: Status above a meal's name when its time passed and it was neither marked eaten nor skipped.
en: Not marked
es: Sin marcar

comment: Status above a meal's name for a meal still ahead today, after the next one. Followed by '· in 3 hr'.
en: Later today
es: Más tarde hoy

comment: Line under a meal's time when the day started late and the meal moved. %@ is the time the plan gives, e.g. 08:00.
en: Moved from %@ today
es: Movida hoy · en el plan a las %@

comment: Line under a meal's time on another day when that day started late and the meal moved. %@ is the time the plan gives, e.g. 08:00.
en: Moved from %@
es: Movida · en el plan a las %@

comment: Assistant button in the nutrition card of a meal that has no figures: the assistant works out calories and macros. Title Case.
en: Estimate Nutrition
es: Estimar nutrición

comment: Line in the nutrition card above the 'Estimate Nutrition' button, when the plan gives no figures for the meal.
en: Your plan doesn't list nutrition for this meal.
tr: Planında bu öğünün besin değerleri yok.
es: Tu plan no indica la nutrición de esta comida.

comment: Footnote in the nutrition card when the figures are the assistant's estimate.
en: Estimated by the assistant from this meal's description. Numbers from your plan always come first.
tr: Asistan bu öğünün açıklamasından tahmin etti. Planındaki değerler her zaman önce gelir.
es: Estimado por el asistente a partir de la descripción de esta comida. Los números de tu plan siempre van primero.

comment: Caption under the protein, carbohydrate and fat bars: what the length of each bar means.
en: Bars show each one's share of the energy.
tr: Çubuklar her birinin enerjideki payını gösterir.
es: Las barras muestran qué parte de la energía aporta cada uno.

comment: Shown under 'Estimate Nutrition' when there was no connection. The allowance was not used.
en: You seem to be offline. Nothing was counted; try again when you're connected.
tr: İnternete bağlı değilsin gibi görünüyor. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi; bağlanınca yeniden dene.
es: Parece que no tienes conexión. No se ha descontado nada; vuelve a intentarlo cuando tengas conexión.

comment: Shown under 'Estimate Nutrition' when the assistant had too many requests. The allowance was not used.
en: The assistant is busy right now. Nothing was counted; try again in a moment.
tr: Asistan şu an çok yoğun. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi; birazdan yeniden dene.
es: El asistente está ocupado ahora mismo. No se ha descontado nada; vuelve a intentarlo en un momento.

comment: Shown under 'Estimate Nutrition' when this phone reached the assistant's daily limit. The allowance was not used.
en: That's all the assistant can do from this iPhone today. Nothing was counted; try again tomorrow.
tr: Asistan bugün bu iPhone için daha fazlasını yapamıyor. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi; yarın yeniden dene.
es: El asistente no puede hacer más desde este iPhone por hoy. No se ha descontado nada; vuelve a intentarlo mañana.

comment: Shown under 'Estimate Nutrition' when the assistant could not estimate the meal. The allowance was not used.
en: The assistant couldn't estimate this meal. Nothing was counted.
tr: Asistan bu öğünü tahmin edemedi. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi.
es: El asistente no pudo estimar esta comida. No se ha descontado nada.

comment: Title of the assistant card on a meal's screen that opens step-by-step cooking. Title Case.
en: How to Make It
es: Cómo prepararla

comment: Line under 'How to Make It' before the recipe is written.
en: Step by step, with what can replace each ingredient.
tr: Adım adım, her malzemenin yerine ne koyabileceğinle birlikte.
es: Paso a paso, con qué puede sustituir a cada ingrediente.

comment: Line under 'How to Make It' once the recipe was written and kept on the phone.
en: Your recipe is ready. Opening it again is free.
es: Tu receta está lista. Volver a abrirla es gratis.

comment: Small badge on 'How to Make It' when the recipe is already written: opening it costs nothing.
en: Ready · Free to open
es: Lista · Abrirla es gratis

comment: Small badge on 'How to Make It': how many assistant uses are left this month, before tapping.

es.one: Te queda %lld uso del asistente este mes
es.many: Te quedan %lld usos del asistente este mes
es.other: Te quedan %lld usos del asistente este mes

comment: Small badge on 'How to Make It' when this month's free assistant uses are used up. Tapping explains DietFlow Plus.
en: Free uses used up · More with Plus
tr: Ücretsiz hakların bitti · Plus ile daha fazlası
es: Usos gratis agotados · Más con Plus

comment: Heading over the foods a meal's description lists, one per row.
en: Ingredients
es: Ingredientes

comment: Heading over a meal's description when it reads as text rather than a list of foods.
en: Description
es: Descripción

comment: Fixed safety line under a meal's ingredients.
en: Check against your allergies and your dietitian's advice.
tr: Alerjilerini ve diyetisyeninin önerilerini göz önünde bulundur.
es: Compruébalo con tus alergias y los consejos de tu dietista.

comment: Footer under the nutrition fields of the meal editor while they hold the assistant's estimate.
en: Estimated by the assistant. Change any number and yours are kept instead.
tr: Asistan tahmin etti. Bir sayıyı değiştirirsen seninkiler geçerli olur.
es: Estimado por el asistente. Si cambias algún número, se guardan los tuyos.

comment: Header of today's day on the Plan tab. %@ is the day's usual header, e.g. 'Day 3 · Tuesday, October 6'.
en: Today · %@
es: Hoy · %@

comment: Line above a meal's name on the Plan tab: %1$@ is the time, %2$@ the sitting (Breakfast).
Line under a meal on the Plan tab when the day started late and the meal moved. %@ is the time the plan gives.
en: Moved from %@
es: Movida · en el plan a las %@

comment: Title of the assistant card on the Plan tab: the assistant works out calories and macros for every meal without them. Title Case.
Line under 'Add Nutrition to N Meals' on the Plan tab.
en: The assistant works out calories and macros from each meal's description. Your plan's own numbers stay as they are.
tr: Asistan her öğünün açıklamasından kalori ve makroları hesaplar. Planındaki değerlere dokunulmaz.
es: El asistente calcula las calorías y los macros a partir de la descripción de cada comida. Los números de tu plan no cambian.

comment: Badge on 'Add Nutrition to N Meals': the whole plan costs one assistant use; %lld uses are left this month.

en.one: 1 AI use for the whole plan · %lld left this month
en.other: 1 AI use for the whole plan · %lld left this month

tr.one: Tüm plan için 1 asistan hakkı · bu ay %lld hakkın kaldı
tr.other: Tüm plan için 1 asistan hakkı · bu ay %lld hakkın kaldı

es.one: 1 uso del asistente para todo el plan · te queda %lld este mes
es.many: 1 uso del asistente para todo el plan · te quedan %lld este mes
es.other: 1 uso del asistente para todo el plan · te quedan %lld este mes

comment: Badge on 'Add Nutrition to N Meals' when plenty of uses are left: the whole plan costs one assistant use.
en: 1 AI use for the whole plan
es: 1 uso del asistente para todo el plan

comment: Badge on 'Add Nutrition to N Meals' when this month's free assistant uses are used up. Tapping explains DietFlow Plus.
en: Free uses used up · More with Plus
tr: Ücretsiz hakların bitti · Plus ile daha fazlası
es: Usos gratis agotados · Más con Plus

comment: Shown on the Plan tab while the assistant estimates the plan's nutrition. %lld is the number of distinct dishes.
Line under 'The assistant is reading N dishes…'.
en: Each meal fills in when it's ready, marked ≈.
tr: Her öğün hazır olunca ≈ işaretiyle dolar.
es: Cada comida se completa cuando está lista, marcada con ≈.

comment: Shown on the Plan tab when the assistant has filled in nutrition. %lld is the number of meals.

es.one: Se añadió la nutrición a %lld comida.
es.many: Se añadió la nutrición a %lld comidas.
es.other: Se añadió la nutrición a %lld comidas.

comment: Line under 'Added nutrition to N meals.'.
en: Estimates are marked ≈. Tap a meal to see them.
tr: Tahminler ≈ ile işaretli. Görmek için bir öğüne dokun.
es: Las estimaciones llevan ≈. Toca una comida para verlas.

comment: Shown on the Plan tab when the plan's estimate failed for lack of a connection. The allowance was not used.
en: You seem to be offline. Nothing was counted.
tr: İnternete bağlı değilsin gibi görünüyor. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi.
es: Parece que no tienes conexión. No se ha descontado nada.

comment: Shown on the Plan tab when the assistant had too many requests. The allowance was not used.
en: The assistant is busy right now. Nothing was counted.
tr: Asistan şu an çok yoğun. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi.
es: El asistente está ocupado ahora mismo. No se ha descontado nada.

comment: Shown on the Plan tab when this phone reached the assistant's daily limit. The allowance was not used.
en: That's all the assistant can do from this iPhone today. Nothing was counted.
tr: Asistan bugün bu iPhone için daha fazlasını yapamıyor. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi.
es: El asistente no puede hacer más desde este iPhone por hoy. No se ha descontado nada.

comment: Shown on the Plan tab when the assistant could not estimate the plan. The allowance was not used.
en: The assistant couldn't estimate this plan. Nothing was counted.
tr: Asistan bu planı tahmin edemedi. Hakkından bir şey düşülmedi.
es: El asistente no pudo estimar este plan. No se ha descontado nada.

comment: Button under a failed nutrition estimate on the Plan tab. Title Case.
en: Try Again
es: Reintentar

comment: VoiceOver label of the close button on the nutrition estimate's result on the Plan tab.
en: Dismiss
es: Cerrar

comment: Under the plan's name on the Plan tab, before the plan starts. %@ is a date like 'Monday, October 12'.
en: Starts %@
es: Empieza el %@

comment: Under the plan's name on the Plan tab, after the plan's last day. %@ is a date like 'October 20'.
en: Ended %@
es: Terminó el %@
